newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Nearby Sydney wheat futures show light change.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Nearby Sydney wheat futures show light change.

text.p: Stepped-up trading left nearby wheat on the Sydney Futures Exchange down or unchanged on Friday, while far forward months gained.
Most active January wheat ended the last trading session of the week unchanged at A$157.50 a tonne, while March wheat slipped 50 cents to A$159.50 a tonne.
Grains traders said the local trading largely mirrored overnight U.S. trading, where nearby CBOT wheat contracts lost ground on aggressive fund selling.
Also, some uncertainty over what action the Australian Wheat Board may take when it next releases its pool price at 0700 GMT (5:00 pm.) on October 7, sidelined some market participants, traders said.
